andrew-partnerships: Kicking off ZA (Cape Town / africa-south1) GCP marketplace onboarding with NVIDIA partner for dedicated GPU capacity. Target: end of Q3. Need quota approvals, marketplace listing, partner entitlements, and SKU signoff. cc @maria-cloudops @devon-sales :wave:

maria-cloudops: Thanks — can you list expected GPU types + initial counts? Also need project IDs and service account that will request quotas. Is this Dedicated (reserved) or shared hosted capacity?

andrew-partnerships: Initial plan = Dedicated pool for enterprise customers + fallback on hosted. Start w/ 12 T4s (burst to 24) and 4 A100s for heavy customers. Projects: redwood-za-prod and redwood-za-staging. SA for quota requests: infra-za-quota@redwood.com

devon-sales: Putting partner legal contact on thread: NVIDIA rep is emma.nuv@nv-partners.com. We'll need co-marketing/announcement runway too — ask marketing for embargo windows.

sanjeev-partner-eng: NVIDIA marketplace entitlement requires partner ID + partner license agreement signed. Tech tasks: enable GPU SKUs in marketplace listing, add container images, and provide deploy manifest. Also will need KMS/HSM mapping for keys. Quick quota command we used for EU rollout: 

```bash
# example quota request (adjust counts)
gcloud compute project-info add-metadata redwood-za-prod \
  --metadata=enable-stackdriver=true

gcloud compute accelerators create-request \
  --project=redwood-za-prod \
  --region=africa-south1 \
  --accelerator-type=nvidia-tesla-t4 \
  --accelerator-count=12
```

sanjeev-partner-eng: I'll draft the partner entitlements doc and the marketplace manifest today. Need partner ID from devon + signed MOU for entitlement.

kelsey-legal: Heads up — region-specific data transfer clauses and local sovereignty addendum required for ZA. Also need to confirm NVIDIA's redistribution rights for images in marketplace. I need a week to review once the draft is in.

andrew-partnerships: Created a spreadsheet for capacity & timelines — please add numbers + contact rows: https://tiny.redwood/cape-town-marketplace (edit access for partnerships + cloudops). Propose sync Wed 09:30 UTC to align launch checklist.

maria-cloudops: Capacity ops can provision 12 T4s in staging within 48h and spin up up to 20 in prod within 5 business days once quota approved. We'll run a 1-hour soak + load test (JMeter) before switching traffic. Add desired QPS and latency SLOs to spreadsheet.

devon-sales: Marketing asks for firm launch date by next Wed to book PR slots. We can aim for Sept 15 if legal + partner entitlements are done by Sept 1. :crossed_fingers:

sanjeev-partner-eng: NVIDIA requires a license key exchange step for A100 images — will need HSM access and a secure endpoint. Can infra add firewall rule to allow NV-license.east1 -> redwood-za-prod?

marketplace-bot: :white_check_mark: Checklist created: [Marketplace listing], [Partner entitlement], [Quota request], [Legal review], [Capacity provisioning], [Co-marketing]. See: https://console.redwood.com/marketplace/checklists/1839990123

kelsey-legal: I'll review the draft by Tue EOD. Please tag me in the marketplace manifest PR.

andrew-partnerships: Action items recap: 1) devon: confirm partner ID + signed MOU (due 8/30). 2) sanjeev: draft entitlement + manifest (due 8/28). 3) maria: submit quota requests with infra SA (submit by 8/26). 4) kelsey: legal review (by 9/1). 5) marketing/devon: firm launch date (by 9/1). I'll schedule the Wed sync and invite infra + partner reps.

maria-cloudops: I'll start the quota ticket now and paste request ID here once created.

marketplace-bot: Quota request created: QRT-78321 (status: pending approval). Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas?project=redwood-za-prod

andrew-partnerships: Great — please drop any blocker notes in the spreadsheet. If partner legal stalls, we fall back to hosted-only offering for initial customers to keep timeline.

devon-sales: noted. I'll loop in Emma (NVIDIA) and marketing this afternoon.

sanjeev-partner-eng: One more note: for perf testing we should include small prompt-caching experiments to validate KV cache effectiveness at 256 token context. Will add to load test plan.

andrew-partnerships: Thanks team. Sync invite sent for Wed 09:30 UTC. :calendar:
